quote: Having an empty block in `onDispose` is not a good practice. Always reconsider to see if there's an effect that fits your use case better.
note: 官方 side-effects 頁明講 onDispose 空是不良實務、應改用更合適的效應;頁面沒逐字寫 SideEffect/LaunchedEffect 取代,但 LaunchedEffect/SideEffect 兩節各自說明用途,與型錄標準寫法一致。

quote: As `LaunchedEffect` is a composable function, it can only be used inside other composable functions.
note: 官方頁並用 rememberCoroutineScope + onClick 內 scope.launch 的範例('Create a new coroutine in the event handler'),與型錄標準寫法相符。

quote: If the change of a variable shouldn't cause the effect to restart, the variable should be wrapped in
note: 同段原文接 rememberUpdatedState;另有 'Restarting effects more than they should could be inefficient.'。頁面未講「請求重送」,屬合理推論。

quote: `snapshotFlow` runs its block when collected and emits the result of the `State` objects read in it.
note: 官方說明 snapshotFlow 只對區塊內讀到的 State 物件發射;範例讀 listState.firstVisibleItemIndex。「永不發射」是由此推得的後果,頁面未逐字寫。

quote: Compose considers standard collection interfaces (`List`, `Set`, and `Map`) unstable because their underlying implementations may be mutable.
note: 型錄的「舊編譯器下不可跳過」成立:頁面說 Kotlin 2.0.20 前或關 strong skipping 時不穩定參數一律重組。注意官方現在還警告:strong skipping 下改 ImmutableList 會每次逐元素 equals,可能更慢;標準寫法宜加註「先量測」。

quote: Using an unstable receiver is usually a bug, so this lint offers a warning to raise this issue.
note: Slack compose-lints 官方規則頁。同頁也說「largely obsoleted by Strong Skipping」,所以「永遠重組」只在舊編譯器/關 strong skipping 時成立,建議型錄後果補條件。

quote: Incorrectly annotating a class could cause recomposition to break or degrade performance.
note: 同頁警告這兩個註解只是對編譯器的契約、不會讓類別真的不可變,並說可能導致「composable not recomposing when you expect it to」,與型錄後果(該重組被跳過、畫面過期)一致。

quote: When you are passing frequently changing State variables into modifiers, you should use the lambda versions of the modifiers whenever possible.
note: 官方 Defer reads 一節同時給 offset { IntOffset } 與 drawBehind { drawRect(color) } 範例,並說 background(color) 版本每幀重組。與型錄完全吻合。

quote: The scroll parameter is now a lambda. That means `Title` can still reference the hoisted state, but the value is only read inside `Title`
note: 官方 Jetsnack 範例:原本父層傳 scroll.value,改傳 scrollProvider lambda,重組範圍縮到子層,與型錄一致。

quote: Prefer primitive types such as `Int`, `Long`, or `String`, and never use list indexes or `hashCode()` as keys.
note: Android 官方效能最佳實務明禁 hashCode 當 key;Slack 規則頁另說 hashCodes are not guaranteed to be unique(碰撞)。

quote: A common use case for this are for functions that only need to be composable in order to read
note: 官方 API 文件:此註解用在只讀 CompositionLocal 的 composable,「slightly more efficient code」,與型錄「微效能損失」一致;Slack 規則 ComposeReadOnlyComposable 對應。

quote: @NonRestartableComposable removes the wrapper’s restart and skip boundary.
note: Slack 官方規則頁說明轉傳函式標此註解可去掉多餘 restart group;Android 穩定性頁也說可視情況標 non-restartable 省開銷。官方也警告別過度優化,屬微效能。

quote: Compose is able to reuse compositions only between the items of the same type.
note: 官方 Lists 頁 'Consider adding contentType';效能最佳實務也寫 Always specify `contentType` for heterogeneous lists。「捲動卡」為程度推論。

quote: To combat this, you can provide a stable and unique key for each item, providing a block to the `key` parameter.
note: 官方只講 key 須穩定且唯一,常數 key 違反「唯一」;重複 key 崩潰與 androidx:ConstantContentStateKeyInItemsCall 的規則說明頁沒抓到(原始檔 404、搜尋無果),所以「崩潰」後果與規則名未獲逐字佐證,但主張不相反。

quote: trying to nest a child `LazyColumn` without a fixed height inside a vertically scrollable `Column` parent
note: 官方 Lists 頁 Avoid nesting components scrollable in the same direction:範例註解 throws IllegalStateException,並建議單一 LazyColumn + item{} / items()。與型錄一致。

quote: can cause performance issues, since all the items will be composed and laid out whether or not they are visible.
note: 官方 Lists 頁 Lazy lists 一節。同頁也說不需捲動的小清單用 Column 即可,型錄「上百項」條件合理。

quote: That would cause the Lazy layout to compose all of its items in the first measurement, as their height is 0 pixels
note: 官方 Avoid using 0-pixel sized items;也說用 placeholder 維持捲動位置。與型錄一致。

quote: If one element becomes visible on the screen, then all elements corresponding to the item have to be composed and measured.
note: 官方 Beware of putting multiple elements in one item,並說會干擾 scrollToItem/animateScrollToItem 索引。官方也說分隔線等小元素放同一 item 是合理例外。

quote: Element functions MUST accept a parameter of type `Modifier`.
note: Compose API guidelines 官方文件,Android modifiers 頁也寫 It's a best practice to have all of your composables accept a modifier parameter。

quote: should name the parameter modifier and assign the parameter a default value of `Modifier`
note: compose-rules 官方文件。API guidelines 另有 MUST appear as the first optional parameter。後果「風格」與型錄一致。

quote: MUST appear as the first optional parameter in the element function's parameter list.
note: 命名、預設值 Modifier、第一個選填參數均有官方原文;「預設帶 padding 會被呼叫端覆蓋」未逐字找到,但與「預設值應為 Modifier」不矛盾。

quote: Modifiers should be applied once as a first modifier in the chain to the root-most layout
note: compose-rules 官方文件;API guidelines 也寫 by passing it to the root element function they call。

quote: Modifiers which are passed in are designed so that they should be used by a single layout node
note: Slack compose-lints 與 compose-rules 同旨;「padding 被套兩次」是直接推論。

quote: We can address this by simply reordering the modifiers.
note: compose-rules 的 Modifier order matters 範例把 clickable 放到 clip/background 之後;Android 官方 modifiers 頁也說 The order of modifier functions is significant。

quote: This API is no longer recommended due to the performance issues it created.
note: 官方 custom-modifiers 頁指 composed {} 不再建議並推 Modifier.Node;「不可跳過」另有一節:composable factory modifiers 回傳值所以 never skipped。

quote: Like all composable functions, a composable factory modifier must be called from within composition.
note: 官方明列 composable modifier factory 三個限制(CompositionLocal 取呼叫處的值、never skipped、只能在組合內呼叫),並說非 composable 工廠可提升到組合外。官方並未說不可用,只是有代價,型錄「不能在非組建處用」屬其一。ComposableModifierFactory 規則名未獲證。

quote: When creating custom modifiers, don't break the modifier chain. You must always reference `this` or else any modifiers previously added will be dropped.
note: 官方文件與 androidx lint 原始碼說明字串(ModifierFactoryExtensionFunction/ReturnType/UnreferencedReceiver)皆一致,後果「鏈被截斷、前面 modifier 遺失」逐字吻合。

quote: which results in modifiers such as padding being applied twice, for example.
note: androidx 官方 lint 原始碼說明字串:隱含 receiver 的工廠放進 then() 會讓 this 被加兩次;修法為直接 this.otherModifier() 或 this.then(Modifier.otherModifier())。

quote: ModifierNodeElements may override inspectableProperties() to provide information about the modifier in the layout inspector.
note: androidx 官方 lint 說明字串:預設以反射讀屬性,可能描述不完整,所以建議覆寫。這是「建議」性質,後果「Layout Inspector 看不到」略強,實為描述不全。

quote: If you read a CompositionLocal in onAttach() or onDetach(), you will only get the CompositionLocal's value once
note: androidx lint 原文建議在 measure()/draw() 等使用當下讀取,或用 ObserverNode + observeReads。官方 custom-modifiers 頁的 ScrollableNode 範例在 onAttach 讀取但同時用 observeReads 監看,與此不衝突(型錄應註明「未配 observeReads」)。

quote: Objects implementing this interface are notified of their usage in
note: 官方 RetainObserver 文件說明 retain 的生命週期要靠 RetainObserver 回呼,並說 remember 的物件收不到 RetainObserver 回呼、應實作 RememberObserver。「retain 一個只實作 RememberObserver 的物件會錯/丟例外」我只在搜尋摘要看到,頁面逐字未取得(retain 函式頁過長沒讀到),也沒找到 RetainRememberObserver 規則說明頁;主張方向不相反,標準寫法有官方依據。
